model.label: Z-Image-Turbo
model.size_rule: bytes = sum over the quantizable Linear weights of params * bits / 8, bits = 8 + 32/K for INT8 (one fp32 scale per output row, K = in_features) and b + (16 + b)/128 for INT4/3/2 (an fp16 scale and a b-bit zero point per 128), 16 for unquantized; plus every other transformer parameter at 2 bytes. Original = every transformer parameter at 2 bytes (the BF16 model). The text encoder and the VAE are not counted

quantization: weight-only fake-quant (RTN): INT8 per output row (symmetric, fp32 scale); INT4/3/2 per 128 inputs with an fp16 scale and an integer zero point; activations, text encoder and VAE unquantized
objective: D = sum over the recorded forwards of ||v_q - v||^2 / sum ||v||^2, where v is the unquantized transformer's output (the flow velocity) on the inputs it received during the 8-forward generation of each table prompt, and v_q the quantized one on the same inputs. Table: one Linear quantized at a time; the knapsack sums D over layers (additive assumption); the measured D quantizes every layer of a setup at once

prompts: A ceramic teapot on a wooden table next to a window, soft afternoon light, product photograph
A street food stall at night with steam rising from noodle bowls and glowing signs, cinematic photo
A shop sign that reads 'OPEN DAILY 9-6' in white letters on a green board
Close-up portrait of an old fisherman in a knitted cap, natural light, photograph
calibration.rule: prompt k uses seed 42+k; every transformer forward of its 8-forward generation

evaluation.rule: the evaluation prompts (none is a table prompt), seed 1042+k, the same latents for every setup
evaluation.metric: PSNR (dB) and SSIM of the decoded image against the unquantized model's image, mean over prompts
